title: OpenAI launches GPT-5 with improved reasoning
content_text: OpenAI announced the release of GPT-5, its latest large language model featuring significantly improved reasoning capabilities. The new model achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks and is now available via API. CEO Sam Altman called it a major step forward for AI.

title: Local council approves new parking regulations
content_text: The city council voted 7-4 to approve new parking regulations that will take effect next month. The changes affect metered parking in the downtown core and increase rates by 15 percent.

content_text: Apple today released iOS 20, introducing new privacy controls including enhanced app tracking transparency and on-device processing for Siri. The update is available for iPhone 12 and later.
